title: Preventive Maintenance of Road: Asphalt Overlay, Iloilo- Antique RD., San Jose, Antique
description: PREVENTIVE MAINTENANCE OF ROAD: ASPHALT OVERLAY - ILOILO- ANTIQUE RD. - K0096 + 208 - K0096 + 640, SAN JOSE, ANTIQUE
colour_meaning: Look first: an official warning record, or two signs of risk together.

reasons.title: A bidder has a reported link to an official or investigation
reasons.detail: ALLENCON DEVELOPMENT CORPORATION: documented link to James "Jojo" Ang Jr. (House representative, Uswag Ilonggo party-list): ICI and DPWH recommended criminal and administrative cases to the Ombudsman against eight lawmakers whose or whose families' firms won DPWH contracts (about 1,300 projects, 2016-20 [recommended, 2025-11-26; as reported]
reasons.evidence: From the team's register of company–person links reported in the news or hearings. Reported, not proven.
checks: Read the source article; confirm the link is stated there, not inferred.
Look for an official document (SEC filing, COA report, Ombudsman complaint) that confirms it.

reasons.title: A bidder had a contract terminated before
reasons.detail: A.D. Pendon Construction & Supply, Inc.: 1 of 191 earlier road contracts terminated; F. Gurrea Construction, Incorporated: 1 of 100 earlier road contracts terminated
reasons.evidence: In past contracts, a winner with an earlier termination had about 2.1 times the odds of another; this held on 2023–2025 data.
checks: Open the terminated contracts listed under Bidders and see why they ended (COA report, DPWH order).
Check whether the firm with the termination record is the winner.

claude_note:
**Claude check (advice only):** Figures (432 m, ₱16.5M ABC, three bidders) match DPWH; the alert is a news-reported family link whose page could not be opened, so first confirm it concerns this same firm.
**Sources:** DPWH API confirms figures; news link could not open · **Suggested next step:** check the source by hand
